articles.title: Elon Musk’s missed promises at Tesla and SpaceX
articles.dek: Fifteen years of public claims that turned out wrong, from full self-driving “next year” to people on Mars. Most are missed forecasts rather than proven lies. Where a court or regulator ruled, the entry says so.
articles.author: Nicholas Leopold
articles.keywords: Elon Musk Tesla SpaceX promises predictions full self-driving FSD robotaxi Cybertruck Roadster Semi Optimus Mars Starship Starlink

articles.title: ASTS Update: why the stock fell, and why Starlink’s politics are its opening
articles.dek: No news, bad news and rising rates have dragged a pre-revenue stock down with its peers. Until revenue arrives in 2027, the price will trade on macro. The case for buying weekly stands.
articles.author: Nicholas Leopold
articles.keywords: AST SpaceMobile ASTS Starlink Elon Musk satellites rates
